description: Welcoming members interested in problem solving and the study of Mars.
summary:
Mars Atlas is an interactive map of the Martian surface, primarily based on satellite images. It is designed to provide explorers a complete view of the Martian surface & topography, along with important features like wind patterns, radiation levels, mineral abundance and heat distribution. It uses available data regarding these features of Mars to overlay distribution charts (of these features) onto the Martian map (which uses the satellite map of NASA's Mars Trek), proving useful for mission planning and astronaut EVA suit helmets' heads-up displays(HUDs). Additionally, available surface images have been added as panoramic viewports.
[Coding and debugging of the project were facilitated by Figma agentic AI and Google Gemini AI.]
